Hi Lisa / Tom — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary use: anonymized clinical summarization (PHI-lite, but potential for protected data in narrow workflows).
- Main compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type II (required for procurement), GDPR data processing controls for EU patients, and longer-term interest in ISO 27001 and FedRAMP for upcoming federal pilots.
- Timeline: procurement review in ~6–8 weeks; security review (docs + questionnaire) expected this month.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) You to share the completed vendor security questionnaire PDF (we can ingest and map to controls) — Lisa noted procurement would open it today.
2) Redwood to provide SOC 2 scoping guidance and a short one-pager on what we can deliver for a SOC 2 evidence package (control mappings, supporting docs). Attached the one-pager for initial review.
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your engineering/security team (30–45 min) to walk through data flows and encryption at rest/in transit. Proposed slots: Thu 7/16 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 7/17 9:00–10:00 PT.

Cc’ing Vivek to pick up on the SOC/ISO/FedRAMP scoping and Marissa for the procurement/contract questions (credits/contract term).

Attachments: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Jordan

Hi Lisa / Tom — nice to meet you (virtually). Quick answers ahead of our call: 

1) SOC 2: We have an existing SOC 2 Type II covering our hosted inference API and control plane (covering availability, confidentiality, and change management controls). We can share a redacted copy under NDA. If procurement needs a template SOC readiness summary instead, we can produce that within 3 business days.

2) ISO / FedRAMP: ISO 27001 is on our roadmap for H2 2027; FedRAMP is exploring longer-term (customer-driven) plans — we can discuss minimum scope for an agency pilot, but that would be a multi-quarter program.

3) GDPR & Data Residency: We offer region-pin for data storage (US, EU) and maintain a subprocessors list — will share the current list and the data flow diagram as pre-read.

4) HIPAA / BAA: We execute BAAs for customers with covered PHI use cases. To speed internal review, I recommend we provide our BAA template and a short summary of administrative/technical safeguards that map to required HIPAA controls.

Proposed immediate deliverables (we'll share these in the Drive link and HubSpot):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (NDA)
- SOC readiness summary (3 business days)
- Subprocessors list + data flow diagram (24 hours)
- BAA template and HIPAA control summary (2 business days)

Looking forward to the call. Jordan — if you want, I can draft suggested questionnaire responses for the technical sections during/after the call (we'll add comments in the PDF).

Best,
